newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian police fight protesters at nightfall.
newsitem.headline: Albanian police fight protesters at nightfall.

text.p: Albanian riot police, some firing shots into the air, clashed with protesters on Wednesday as they tried to disperse thousands of people gathered in this southern city to demand refunds from a collapsed savings fund.

Reuters correspondent Benet Koleka said around 200 police and over 1,000 demonstrators hurled stones at each other after nightfall in the centre of the port city. Police also used dogs and a water cannon to try to disperse the crowd.
Many shots were fired into the air but it was not clear if the police used live or blank rounds. The police also pounded their riot shields with battons as they advanced on the crowd.
Around 7,000 people were marching through the city, chanting anti-government slogans, when the police made their move. Some of the crowd fled, but others fought back, breaking the police lines.
An earlier attempt to break up the demonstrators failed and thousands more people joined the crowd during the afternoon, including children and people on crutches.

Wednesday's demonstration was the first large scale protest in Albania for over a week. Widespread rioting swept the Balkan state last month following the collapse of a number of get-rich-quick investment schemes.
